title: MELTDOWN
sub: फ़ुकुशिमा: रिएक्टर के अंदर क्या हुआ
en: Even a shut-down reactor can melt.
After the power was lost, the water in the reactor began to boil.
The water kept falling, and the fuel rods were left exposed.
The fuel melted and collected at the bottom of the reactor.
At the same time, hydrogen gas formed and filled up under the roof.
On 12 March, unit 1 exploded. Then units 3 and 4.
It was rated a level 7 accident, the same as Chernobyl.
For the full story, subscribe to the channel.
